A_Programmable_Array_Logic_(PAL)_is_a_pr:
A Programmable Array Logic (PAL) is a programmable
logic device semiconductors used to  implement any logic
function in only one digital circuit. The function is
stateless, which means that no intermediate state is saved.
If_the_input_J_is_1_(high)_and_K_is_0_(l:
If the input J is 1 (high) and K is 0 (low)
during a clock pulse, the output becomes 1 (high).
If J is 0 (low) and K is 1 (high) during the pulse,
the output becomes 0 (low). If both inputs are 0 (low)
during the clock pulse, the state is maintained. If both
inputs are 1 (high) the input is toggled if a rising edge
was detected at the clock input.

output is 0 (low), if the input is bigger or
equal to 30V, the output will be 1 (high). For
all voltages in between, the output does not change.
